faq.q: Where can I join German classes in Dehradun?
faq.a: Language Zone runs German classes in Dehradun at our centre Near Dwarka Store, EC Road, Race Course, above Admire Honda, near Survey Chowk, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248001, and online. Courses cover every level from A1 to C2, each preparing you for its Goethe-Zertifikat exam.

faq.q: Which German level should a beginner start with?
faq.a: Complete beginners start with the German A1 course. If you have studied German before, a free level check with one of our trainers in Dehradun places you in A2, B1 or a higher batch.

faq.q: Do you prepare students for the Goethe-Zertifikat exam in Dehradun?
faq.a: Yes. Every German course at Language Zone follows the syllabus of its Goethe-Zertifikat, from A1: Start Deutsch 1 to the C2 Großes Deutsches Sprachdiplom, with mock tests in the real exam format and guidance on registration.

faq.q: Are online German classes available, or only offline in Dehradun?
faq.a: Both. Join offline German classes at our Near Dwarka Store, EC Road, Race Course, above Admire Honda, near Survey Chowk, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248001, or learn online from anywhere in Uttarakhand and India. Morning, evening and personalised batches are available.

faq.q: Which German Language Institute in Dehradun offers Goethe-Zertifikat preparation?
faq.a: Language Zone is a German Language Institute in Dehradun that prepares learners for Goethe-Zertifikat examinations at different proficiency levels, from A1 to C2. Students can develop their speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills through structured learning and trainer guidance.

faq.q: How long does it take to learn German up to B1 or B2?
faq.a: It depends on your starting level, how often you attend and how much you practise between classes. After a short level check, a counsellor can give you a realistic timeline for reaching B1 or B2 for your study, work or visa goal.

faq.q: What are the fees for the German language course in Dehradun?
faq.a: Fees depend on the level and the batch you choose. Call +91 88821 40688, message us on WhatsApp or send an enquiry, and we will share the current fees and the next batch dates for your level.
